mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% indicates an easing monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window or 20-day returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rates below 4% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4%, or returns remain negative despite sustained rate decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rates above 4% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4%, or returns remain positive despite sustained rate rise.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in the INDPRO index above 104.5 signals expanding supply capacity, reducing inflation expectations and attracting investor capital, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 104.5, or returns remain flat despite sustained supply growth.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates below 2% and rising demand (GDPC1) creates a favorable environment for equity investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing combined with robust demand
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 growth exceeds 5%, or returns remain negative despite the dual signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2%, or returns remain positive despite the rate hike.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rates below 4% and rising federal funds rates above 2% creates conflicting signals, undermining market confidence and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both UNRATE < 4% and FEDFUNDS > 2%, or returns remain positive despite the dual pressure.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by low federal funds rates below 2% and robust demand growth (GDPC1 > 19800), investors anticipate sustained economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle conditions, or returns remain flat despite sustained low rates and high demand.
